Definition: from G575 and G2346; to crowd (from every side):--press.
BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, when Jesus asks who touched Him and Peter answers that the multitude throng and press Him on every side. It is the crush of a crowd, many hands brushing past, and one touch that is different.
TheologicalSignificance: Crowds press, but faith touches, and Jesus knows the difference.
